company.name: Mobmio
company.shortDescription: Mobmio is a mobile performance network that provides user acquisition, campaign promotion, and monetization services.
company.description: Mobmio is a global mobile performance marketing platform specializing in user acquisition, app growth, and publisher monetization services for mobile-first businesses. The company connects advertisers, app owners, brands, and publishers through a performance-driven ecosystem that supports CPI, CPL, CPA, and revenue-sharing models. Mobmio works with media buying teams, influencers, in-app networks, and digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube to drive high-quality mobile traffic and scalable customer acquisition campaigns.
